configuration: no-strategy / idle-hold (yieldStrategy == address(0)); the path story-009's state machine gates and where principal-conservation arithmetic is exact
roles: handler holds owner + migrator + pauser of the staker, so it drives initiateMigration / batchMigrate / finalizeAndReset / phUSDPerDay / pause directly (the in-scope story-009 hooks; the off-chain StableStakerMigrator is a forwarder and out of scope here)

invariants.name: invariant_stateMachineLegal
invariants.description: poolState[token] is only ever Active(0) or Migrating(1), and always equals the state implied by the transitions the handler actually drove (Active->Migrating via initiateMigration, Migrating->Active via finalizeAndReset). No function leaves a registered token in an illegal or stuck state.

invariants.name: invariant_finalizeResetDrainGate
invariants.description: Every successful finalizeAndReset was preceded by a fully-drained pool (stakerCount==0 && totalStaked==0); post-reset the pool is Active, migrationInfo (R,P) is zeroed, and lastRewardTime==block.timestamp. The handler also asserts the contract REVERTS finalizeAndReset whenever live state remains (negative drain-gate check). No live position survives a reset.

invariants.name: invariant_emissionCap
invariants.description: Total phUSD minted as rewards (== phUSD.totalSupply() in this harness) never exceeds Sum over windows of perSecond_window * activeSeconds_window, where active windows are only those that were Active with totalStaked>0. The Migrating window mints nothing new; finalizeAndReset fast-forwards lastRewardTime so the frozen gap is never retro-accrued. A bounded round-DOWN dust allowance (~2 wei per emitting window, ~1e18x smaller than a single window's emission) is permitted, matching the contract's documented 'dust rounds down' guarantee; anything larger (a real double-mint / retro-accrue) trips the invariant.

invariants.name: invariant_principalConservation
invariants.description: sum(userInfo.amount over the staker set) == poolInfo.totalStaked, every staker-set member has a non-zero position, and the contract's token balance >= totalStaked (idle principal is always fully backed, including across the Migrating window where the realized pile R sits idle).

notes: Harness is deterministic: real FlaxToken + MockERC20, fixed 3-actor set, bounded fuzz inputs (amounts 1..500_000e6, time steps 1..30 days, rates 0..1_000_000 ether/day).

A [profile.invariant] was added to workspace foundry.toml to skip three UNTRACKED, pre-story-009 PoC scratch files (PoC_M02/M03/M04) that reference the removed migrationInfo `bool active` field and no longer compile against story-009. Default profile and the scratch files are untouched.
